status: Reprint the clamp U and clamp bar only: they take M2.5 hardware. The enclosure back and Pi carrier are byte-identical to R006 to R009, which the user has printed.

fastener_size.reason: The Pi 5 mounting holes are 2.7 mm, too small for M3 [@raspberrypi2025Pi5Drawing]; the AI HAT+, the Motor HAT and the PCA9685 already mount with M2.5. Only the clamp and its lock used M3.

fit_test.result: U1 (18.9 mm pocket), chosen by the user from U1-U5 on the tube on 2026-11-03; kept in R010
fit_test.follow_up: If U1 wobbles sideways once the bar is tight, the next step is a pocket 0.3 mm tighter (18.6 mm).

source.parameters: designs/ultraskelly/src/enclosure.json (U1 kept: tube range 18.0 to 18.6, clearance 0.15, arm 9.95, bolt inset 5.45. M2.5: clearance 2.9, head recess 5.1 by 2.7, nut slot 5.4 by 2.6 reaching 3.2 past the axis, body_drop 7.5, lock pilot 2.1, lock screw 16)
source.clamp_files: clamp-u.stl and clamp-bar.stl as exported by the build, byte for byte
source.kept_files: enclosure-back.stl, pi-carrier.stl and their images copied from R009 (the R006 files)
source.images: clamp images rendered from the released files with part_images.py and part_titles.py, run generated/ultraskelly/part-images/r017; enclosure back and carrier images from R006
source.live_reload: live.py compares module paths normalised, so source edits reload in the running FreeCAD. Build r016 ran stale code before this fix and was discarded.

clamp-u.stl.part: Clamp U: U1 pocket (18.9 mm), 20 mm body, 47.5 mm dovetail tongue, M2.5 nut slots and holes, lock pilot
clamp-u.stl.changes_from_r009: Pocket, arms and dovetail profile kept. M2.5 clearance holes (2.9 mm), nut slots (5.4 by 2.6 mm) and a 2.1 mm lock pilot across the tongue; body and tongue start 7.5 mm lower, so the tongue is 47.5 mm tall and reaches the enclosure lock hole. No engraved number.
clamp-u.stl.orientation: Standing on its lower end, tube opening vertical; as exported.

clamp-bar.stl.part: Clamp bar, 20 mm tall, with M2.5 holes and head recesses
clamp-bar.stl.changes_from_r009: Same outline; M2.5 holes and recesses. No engraved number.
clamp-bar.stl.orientation: Flat, screw-head recesses up; as exported.

enclosure-back.stl.part: Enclosure back: frame plate, dovetail channel with a 45 degree chamfer, PCA9685 wing and tie tab
enclosure-back.stl.orientation: Standing on its lower end; as exported. Add a 5 mm brim.
enclosure-back.stl.reproduced: The file keeps the R006 frame. The R010 build (generated/ultraskelly/enclosure/r017) exports the same mesh moved 2.075 mm along -X: equal vertex and face counts, largest vertex difference 3.1e-06 mm after the shift (float32 rounding).

pi-carrier.stl.part: Pi carrier: rail frame with four standoffs on the Pi 5 hole pattern
pi-carrier.stl.orientation: Flat, standoffs facing up; as exported.
pi-carrier.stl.reproduced: The R010 build (generated/ultraskelly/enclosure/r017) exports this file byte-identically.

design_guidance.rule: Strength comes mostly from perimeters; most parts need 10 to 15 % infill, rarely over 30 %; thicker walls raise strength more than infill.
design_guidance.change: Clamp 6 perimeters with 25 % infill; enclosure back and carrier 3 perimeters with 15 % infill.

design_guidance.rule: Gyroid infill has equal strength in all directions and a good strength-to-weight ratio.
At least 3 top layers over sparse infill.
Walls thinner than one perimeter (about 0.45 mm) do not print; walls over 0.8 mm print on any printer.
design_guidance.change: At least three perimeters (1.35 mm) around every clamp screw feature; see parts.clamp-u.stl.walls_mm.

design_guidance.rule: Overhangs up to 45 degrees print without supports (Prusa allows 45 to 60).
design_guidance.change: 45 degree chamfer under the dovetail block, peaked window tops and teardrop PCA9685 bosses.

design_guidance.rule: Bridges sag unless shorter than 5 mm.
design_guidance.change: Peaked window tops; horizontal holes 5.6 mm or smaller; 2.6 mm nut-slot tops; the 20 mm dovetail cap kept as the one bridge.

design_guidance.rule: Edges on the build plate flare; chamfer them where fit matters.
design_guidance.change: 0.5 mm chamfers on the clamp U tube opening and dovetail tongue at the bed.

design_guidance.rule: Thread-forming screws in thermoplastics: pilot 0.8 x diameter with an entry counterbore; printed holes come out undersized.
design_guidance.change: PCA9685 pilots and the tongue lock pilot 2.1 mm (0.84 x 2.5 mm); 2.9 by 0.5 mm counterbores on the PCA9685 bosses; none on the lock pilot, which enters the solid tongue.

design_guidance.rule: FDM parts are weaker between layers; orient structural parts for their load.
design_guidance.change: Clamp loads run along the layers; the bar takes head pressure across them.

design_guidance.rule: Printers are accurate to about 0.2 mm; moving fits start at 0.3 mm clearance.
design_guidance.change: U1 pocket 18.9 mm: 0.15 to 0.45 mm per side on an 18.0 to 18.6 mm tube; 0.3 mm dovetail clearance.

design_guidance.rule: Chamfers rather than fillets on edges facing the bed.
design_guidance.change: Rounded corners only on edges that stand vertical as printed; bed edges keep 0.5 mm chamfers.

design_guidance.rule: Moving fits start at 0.3 mm clearance; vertical holes print undersized.
design_guidance.change: M2.5 clearance holes 2.9 mm, 0.4 mm over the screw as R006 used 3.4 mm for M3; head recesses 5.1 by 2.7 mm for the 4.5 by 2.5 mm head; the enclosure lock hole stays 3.4 mm.

not_covered_by_sources: nut-trap sizes (M2.5 slots 5.4 by 2.6 mm for a 5.0 by 2.0 mm nut: R006 allowance of 0.4 mm over the flats and 0.6 mm over the thickness; narrower than the 5.8 mm across corners, so the nut cannot turn)
screw engagement and boss size in printed parts (PCA9685: about 1.8 x d engagement, 2.2 x d boss; lock screw 10.2 mm, 4.1 x d)
minimum clamp height (20 mm body kept; the M2.5 nut slots leave 2.3 mm above and below and 4.6 mm between)

estimate.method: Not sliced; the Snapmaker Orca command line crashed with the U1 profiles. Per part: side area x walls x 0.45 mm plus flat area x top/bottom layers x 0.2 mm, capped at the solid volume, plus infill in the rest; PETG at 1.27 g/cm3. Time at an average 6 to 10 mm3/s, as on a fast printer such as the U1.

envelope_mm.frame: Builder frame: origin on the axis of an 18.3 mm tube; z = 0 is the enclosure seat datum, the clamp lower end up to R009. The R010 clamp starts 7.5 mm lower, at z = -7.5 (clamp.body_drop).
envelope_mm.measured: Union of the part and board bounding boxes in the r017 document, without the tube.

interfaces.tube: Square tube of 18.0 to 18.6 mm: 18.9 mm pocket; the bar takes up the front-to-back slack
interfaces.dovetail: Tongue root 16, tip 22, depth 6, height 47.5 (z -7.5 to 40), 0.5 mm bed chamfer; mates the unchanged enclosure back channel (0.3 mm clearance)
interfaces.lock: M2.5 x 16 through the 3.4 mm hole in the enclosure block (axis x -16.15, z -4) into a 2.1 mm pilot right across the tongue: 5.5 mm wall, 0.3 mm gap, 10.2 mm engagement in a 19.0 mm tongue; from either side
interfaces.pi: Pi 5 board underside 7.5 mm behind the plate on the carrier standoffs, as on the R004 case

overhangs: Checked on the exported meshes: 45 degree chamfers, peaks and teardrops, holes of 5.6 mm or less, 2.6 mm nut-slot tops, and one 20 mm bridge under the dovetail cap; no supports needed.
robot_clearance: Not assessed. Only the mount size (envelope_mm) and the bare tube length are given.
not_established: the M2.5 clamp U and bar are unprinted; they keep U1 pocket, chosen by hand on the tube; grip under the robot motion untested
printed dimensions, the tube and dovetail fits, the M2.5 nut slots, and the M2.5 threads in the 2.1 mm PCA9685 and tongue pilots
strength of the lighter parts and settings, the clamp grip, and the M2.5 lock screw under robot motion; wear of its thread in the tongue with repeated removal
M2.5 machine screws in the 2.1 mm printed pilots: the 0.8 x d rule is for moulded bosses and thread-forming screws
Motor HAT standoff length (10 or 12 mm, chosen at assembly) and the AI HAT+ spacer threads
wiring: drawn schematically; cable lengths and the bundle route
print time and filament: estimated, not sliced
